summary: Assign the existing Detransitive engagement example to sense 2
rationale: Its couple subjects become engaged; reader D1 is not an existing numbered Detransitive heading.

summary: New box Infectum: example for sense 2 in Infectum (JTM 1.3/8)

data.turoyo: ʕAm i nišaniye kmanṭən əšmo d səkkar, w koṯe u ahəl ahəl, kəmnayšənila.
data.translation: Zu diesem Anlass bringen sie ein paar Süßigkeiten mit, es kommen die nahen Verwandten, und sie verloben (das Mädchen).

rationale: First active Infectum box; family agents betroth the girl, overt object suffix -la.

summary: New box Part. Pass.: example for sense 2 in Part. Pass. (MAC NE Mar Dumet/6)

data.turoyo: Ŭ aǧ+ǧehəl, ak̇+k̇ačk̇at, hak̇a bgawre, ŭ hak̇a ṭlibe, mnayšne, ŭ hak̇a k̇aččək̇at, mhirənne bu+zōr, mhirənne.
data.translation: And the youth, the girls, whether married, or pledged, betrothed, or (just) girls, they married them (i.e., in the Muslim way) by force, they married them.

rationale: First Detransitive Part. Pass. box; plural status mnayšne contrasts with married and unbetrothed girls. Verbal/adjectival boundary is queried.

summary: New box Part. Pass.: example for sense 3 in Part. Pass. (Jan 2.14/3431)

data.turoyo: Azze mawbele, mawbele, mawbele, mawbele, mawbele u ḥawrayḏe ste, kəlle ḥzele an nišanat mnayšne. I dukṯo, d kətyo uʕdo Mor Gabriyel. Qayəm bnalle tamo.
data.translation: He went and took him, took him, took him, took him, took his companion too; there he saw all those signs marked out. The place where Mor Gabriel is now. Then they built it there.

rationale: First example of new Detransitive marking 3 in the Part. Pass. box already established for engagement; overt marked signs and site context.

summary: New box Infectum-wa: example for sense 2 in Infectum-wa (Jan 3.29/743)

data.turoyo: Ǧan: I naqqa d mnayšniwola, əmmiwo "u yamino".
data.translation: Jan: When they betrothed her, they used to say "the right hand".

rationale: First active I.2 Infectum-wa after round 1; explicit feminine patient suffix -la.

summary: New box Preterit: example for sense 2 in Preterit (Jan 4.I/80)

data.turoyo: Alfo w čaʕmo w šwaʕ w əšti (1967), šəbqono šeṯ w šawʕi (1976) mnayšanno w gawərno w hawyo i badayayḏi du fəlḥono baš šutose səryoye.
data.translation: In one thousand nine hundred and sixty-seven (1967), excuse me, seventy-six (1976), I got engaged and married, and my beginning of work in Syriac institutions came about.

rationale: First I Detransitive Preterit box for round-1 engagement 2; first-person form coordinated with marriage.

summary: New sense 2: (Detrans.) sich verloben, verlobt werden; verlobt sein

data.gloss: (Detrans.) sich verloben, verlobt werden; verlobt sein

rationale: Existing unnumbered kminayšni at 4/57 is the Detransitive engagement counterpart of active sense 2, not marking sense 1. MAC NE Mar Dumet/6 adds a result-state form. Label 2 preserves correspondence without changing active numbers.

summary: New sense 3: (Detrans.) bezeichnet, markiert sein;
rationale: An nišanat mnayšne presents the signs/site markings as a result state without a marking agent. This is the Detransitive counterpart of active marking 1, distinct from engagement Detransitive 2 already proposed in round 1. New Detransitive label 3 follows round 1's highest Detransitive label; one attestation.

summary: example for sense 2 in Preterit (MAC NE TERTO ZARE/56)

data.turoyo: Kəmmi, ‘Aḥna kəbʕina i+k̇ačk̇e yatəmto’. Axər ṭliballe, simalle he, ṭliballe, mnayšnalle.
data.translation: They say, ‘We want the orphan girl’. Finally they requested her, they made an agreement, they requested her, they engaged her.

rationale: Thin Preterit engagement cell; plural family agents, distinct from the merchant betrothing himself in the inherited example.

summary: example for sense 1 in Preterit (PrS 59/20)

data.turoyo: Azze Zaydin, mnayšalle i dukṯo d qaṭəʕ u dewo.
data.translation: Seidin aber machte ein Zeichen an dem Orte, wo der Wolf hinübergegangen war.

rationale: Thin Preterit marking cell; independently understood overt place object.

summary: Preserve stem I and mnayšalle/mnayšən as filed, despite denominal/quadriliteral shape. The inherited Kurdish nîšan derivation is not independently proved by these tokens, and a denominal lexical verb is not a light-verb construction.

Active engagement allows the couple member to betroth himself (26/92) and family agents to betroth a girl (JTM 1.3/8; MAC NE TERTO ZARE/56). Both are covered by inherited (sich) verloben; no new active sense.
Detransitive kminayšni has couple subjects and no outside agent; result-state plural mnayšne at MAC NE Mar Dumet/6 is provisionally filed in Part. Pass. Both retain engagement number 2.
PrS 41/30 repeats the inherited cave-marking example cited prs 113/29. 26/92 and 112/254 are likewise already represented; no duplicates.
Retain the glossary's stem I and base forms despite quadriliteral shape. Active betrothing with -la already belongs to sense 2; no new causative engagement sense is needed.

Detransitive Part. Pass. already exists after round 1 for engagement. The marked-site occurrence adds a meaning/cell, not a missing box. Its new Detransitive sense is numbered 3 after round-1 label 2, while active senses remain 1 and 2.
Active Infectum was added in round 1; only active Infectum-wa and Detransitive Preterit are new boxes in this round.
Jan 4.I/80 preserves the speaker's year self-correction (1967 to 1976) verbatim; neither year nor source wording is silently repaired.
MAC NE Mar Dumet/6: is mnayšne synchronically a verbal Detransitive Part. Pass. or a lexical adjective? The betrothed status is clear, but its exact derivation from mnayšən needs confirmation.
Confirm mnayšne at Jan 2.14/3431 as the team's Detransitive Part. Pass. rather than a lexical adjective or another nonfinite formation. The marked-state meaning is secure.
Confirm the first-person Detransitive Preterit segmentation of mnayšanno at Jan 4.I/80; the lack of an l-agent ending and coordination with gawərno favor this assignment.
Supply verified translations for Jan; all added translations are withheld as null.
First-person mnayšanno coordinated with gawərno supports round 1's Detransitive engagement sense 2 without proposing that sense again.
